nodes.label: Full support of zero-temperature SK minimizers
nodes.statement: For any BrownianSystem W and admissible OrderParameter gamma, IsMinimizer W gamma implies FullSupportConclusion W gamma.
nodes.boundary: Pure zero-field SK with covariance normalization xi(t)=t^2/2. Conditional on the supplied order parameter being an admissible integrable minimizer; no separate assertion that a minimizer exists. FullSupportConclusion includes Stieltjes-measure and diffusion existence, full relative support, strict increase, and the two selected diffusion moment identities. It does not assert QAOA circuit-energy convergence.

nodes.boundary: Pure zero-field SK with covariance normalization xi(t)=t^2/2. Conditional on the supplied order parameter being an admissible integrable minimizer; no separate assertion that a minimizer exists. nodes.label: Parisi value identities and finite Gaussian approximation
nodes.statement: The conjunction in OAI.SKValue.value_consequences: scalar value consequences for every minimizer and associated diffusion; finite Gaussian coefficient consequences for 0<T<1; and groundStateValue = parisi W gamma for every minimizer.
nodes.boundary: The first two conjuncts are conditional on IsMinimizer and IsDiffusion; the final Parisi-value equality needs IsMinimizer. These are scalar ground-state value and finite Gaussian approximation statements. They do not assert QAOA circuit-energy convergence or an efficient angle-selection algorithm.

nodes.label: OAI.SKValue.value_consequences
nodes.statement: OAI.SKValue.value_consequences is the three-part universally quantified conjunction specified by ComparatorChallenges.SKValue, implemented from scalar_value_target, finite_gaussian_target, and ground_state_parisi_target.
nodes.boundary: The first two conjuncts are conditional on IsMinimizer and IsDiffusion; the final Parisi-value equality needs IsMinimizer. These are scalar ground-state value and finite Gaussian approximation statements. They do not assert QAOA circuit-energy convergence or an efficient angle-selection algorithm.

nodes.label: QAOA approaches the SK optimum in the thermodynamic-first limit
nodes.statement: For the Gaussian zero-field SK model, lim_{p→∞} Q_p = P_star, where Q_p is the supremum over deterministic p-layer angles of the limiting expected energy per spin as n→∞. Equivalently, for each epsilon>0, some finite p and deterministic angles, independent of n and the disorder, attain at least P_star-epsilon in that limiting expectation.
nodes.boundary: Manuscript-level claim with system size tending to infinity first and circuit depth then increasing; finite deterministic angles depend on the desired accuracy and are independent of system size and disorder. No quantitative finite-size estimate, depth bound, or efficient angle-selection procedure is claimed. The whole manuscript argument has not been independently reviewed here and has no retained Lean circuit-convergence target.

nodes.label: Full-support interface: Brownian system and admissible minimizer
nodes.statement: A measurable sample space, W : BrownianSystem Ω, gamma : OrderParameter, and hmin : IsMinimizer W gamma. OrderParameter packages nonnegativity, monotonicity, right continuity, and integrability on [0,1).
nodes.boundary: These are the premises of the universally quantified target, not independently supplied existence results.

nodes.label: Scalar-value interface: Brownian space and admissible minimizer
nodes.statement: W : BrownianSpace, gamma : OrderParameter, and IsMinimizer W gamma, with the admissibility fields and Parisi functional defined in ComparatorChallenges.SKValue.
nodes.boundary: This records the minimizer premise of the formal interface; it does not assert that a minimizer exists.

nodes.label: Scalar-value interface: associated diffusion for its first two clauses
nodes.statement: X : ℝ → W.Ω → ℝ satisfies IsDiffusion W gamma X; the finite Gaussian clause additionally assumes 0<T and T<1.
nodes.boundary: The diffusion premise belongs to the first two conjuncts of value_consequences. Its final ground-state/Parisi equality has only the minimizer premise.

nodes.label: Gaussian zero-field model and ordered limits
nodes.statement: Independent standard Gaussian couplings, the pure zero-field SK cost Hamiltonian normalized by n^(-1/2), the transverse-field mixer, and deterministic finite-depth angles held fixed while n tends to infinity; circuit depth increases afterward.
nodes.boundary: This is the setting of the manuscript theorem; it is not a finite-instance algorithmic runtime guarantee.
